producer.queue_topic.description: Queue topic for receiving messages to be processed (e.g., 'designate', 'pool_manager').

producer.workers.description: Number of worker processes to spawn for message handling.

producer.max_messages.description: Maximum number of messages each worker processes before restarting (0 = unlimited).

producer.heartbeat_interval.description: Interval in seconds between heartbeat signals sent to the message broker (0 = disable).

producer.rabbit_hosts.description: List of RabbitMQ hosts for message queue connectivity.

items.description: Hostname or IP address of a RabbitMQ node.

producer.rabbit_port.description: Port number used to connect to RabbitMQ.

producer.rabbit_retry_interval.description: Initial retry interval in seconds after a connection failure.

producer.rabbit_retry_backoff.description: Exponential backoff factor for retry delays.

producer.rabbit_retry_max_delay.description: Maximum allowed delay between retries in seconds.

producer.storage_driver.description: Backend storage driver for zone and record management (e.g., 'sqlalchemy', 'memory').

producer.database_pool.description: Enable connection pooling for database access.

producer.database_pool_size.description: Maximum number of connections in the pool.

producer.database_pool_min_size.description: Minimum number of connections retained in the pool.

producer.database_pool_timeout.description: Maximum time to wait for a connection from the pool in seconds.

producer.database_pool_recycle.description: Seconds after which a connection is recycled (0 = disable).

producer.log_date_format.description: Date/time format used in log messages.

producer.log_file.description: Path to the log file (empty = log to stderr).
